SSH · 主机验证与安全通道: SSH · Host verification and a secure channel
提供远程登录、命令执行和端口转发。: Provide remote login, command execution and port forwarding.
服务器使用主机密钥签名证明身份，客户端核验可信的主机密钥、指纹或主机证书，并完成: The server proves its identity by signing with its host key. The client verifies a trusted host key, fingerprint or host certificate and completes key exchange. Identity verification helps detect server impersonation.
在同一连接中打开终端、SFTP或端口转发通道，多个通道共享底层TCP连接。: Open terminal, SFTP or port-forwarding channels in the same connection. Multiple channels share the underlying TCP connection.
服务器默认监听TCP 22: The server listens on TCP 22 by default
SFTP与FTP、FTPS采用不同协议: SFTP uses a different protocol from FTP and FTPS
SSH有自己的密钥交换和数据保护机制。首次连接时应通过可信渠道核验主机指纹；已记: SSH has its own key exchange and data protection. On first connection, verify the host fingerprint through a trusted channel. If a stored fingerprint changes, confirm whether the server key was replaced.
控制连接传命令和回复，数据连接传文件和目录列表。: The control connection carries commands and replies; the data connection carries files and directory listings.
PASV回复服务器的地址和端口，EPSV只回复端口，客户端沿用控制连接的服务器地: PASV returns a server address and port; EPSV returns only a port, using the server address from the control connection.
④ 建连并请求文件: ④ Connect and request a file
客户端主动连接数据端口，并在控制连接上发送RETR。服务器经数据连接向客户端返回: The client initiates the data connection and sends RETR over the control connection. The server returns file data over the data connection and a completion reply over the control connection.
控制和数据连接均使用TCP: Both control and data connections use TCP
FTPS为FTP增加TLS保护: FTPS adds TLS protection to FTP
USER、PASS、LIST、RETR和STOR等命令都在控制连接上传递，LIS: USER, PASS, LIST, RETR and STOR travel over the control connection. Directory contents from LIST return over the data connection. Active mode has the server initiate the data connection, so firewalls and NAT must handle its ports and direction.
图示为被动模式，第四步箭头表示客户端建连和请求，下载数据及中间回复没有单独绘出。: The diagram shows passive mode. The fourth arrow represents client connection establishment and the request; download data and intermediate replies are not drawn separately.
IMAP · 访问邮箱与同步标记: IMAP · Mailbox access and flag synchronization
客户端访问服务器中的邮箱，按需获取内容并同步状态。: Access server-side mailboxes, retrieve content as needed and synchronize state.
按UID获取邮件头、正文或某一部分。UID在一个邮箱的特定UIDVALIDITY: Retrieve headers, bodies or individual parts by UID. A UID is unique within a particular mailbox UIDVALIDITY value; caches must record both.
新邮件通过SMTP提交: New messages are submitted using SMTP
\\\\Seen表示已读，\\\\Deleted表示标记删除；EXPUNGE等操: \\Seen marks a message read; \\Deleted marks it for deletion. Operations such as EXPUNGE permanently remove marked messages. Clients share server-side mailbox state; synchronization depends on supported client and server features.
POP3 · 获取邮件与提交删除: POP3 · Retrieve mail and commit deletion
列出和下载邮件，按客户端指令删除服务器副本。: List and download messages, and delete server copies when instructed by the client.
客户端认证后进入事务阶段。可用隐式TLS或STLS升级保护连接，具体取决于服务配: After authentication, the client enters the transaction state. Implicit TLS or a STLS upgrade can protect the connection, depending on server configuration.
LIST列出邮件编号和大小，RETR返回整封邮件，包括邮件头和正文。客户端通常把: LIST returns message numbers and sizes; RETR returns the complete message, including headers and body. Clients normally store downloaded messages locally.
DELE将邮件标记为删除，此时仍可用RSET撤销标记。未标记的邮件继续保留在服务: DELE marks a message for deletion; RSET can still cancel those marks. Unmarked messages remain on the server.
在事务阶段发送QUIT后进入更新阶段，服务器处理删除。异常断开时，服务器保留此前: QUIT in the transaction state enters the update state, where the server processes deletions. An abnormal disconnect preserves previously marked messages.
下载与删除是分开的操作。DELE在事务阶段记录删除标记，正常QUIT进入更新阶段: Downloading and deleting are separate operations. DELE records marks during the transaction state; a normal QUIT enters the update state and processes them. An update failure may leave only some marked messages deleted.
握手后双方都能主动发送消息，每条消息可由一个或多个帧组成。: After the handshake, either endpoint can send messages, each consisting of one or more frames.
服务器接受升级，返回Sec-WebSocket-Accept等字段，客户端检查应: The server accepts the upgrade and returns fields including Sec-WebSocket-Accept, which the client checks. Accept confirms the WebSocket handshake; user authentication remains an application responsibility.
服务器可随时发送消息。双方可用Ping/Pong检测连接状态，并用Close帧完: The server can send messages at any time. Both endpoints can check connection status with Ping/Pong and close with a Close-frame handshake.
wss通过TLS保护连接: wss protects the connection with TLS
帧首部包括FIN、opcode、MASK和载荷长度等字段。客户端帧必须掩码，服务: Frame headers include FIN, opcode, MASK and payload length. Client frames must be masked; server frames must not be masked. Masking does not provide confidentiality.
图示采用HTTP/1.1 Upgrade，未展开HTTP/2和HTTP/3的扩展: This diagram uses HTTP/1.1 Upgrade and omits extended CONNECT over HTTP/2 and HTTP/3.
BGP · 邻居会话与策略选路: BGP · Neighbor sessions and policy-based routing
向邻居通告前缀和路径属性，为IP转发提供路由信息。: Advertise prefixes and path attributes to neighbors to supply routes for IP forwarding.
双方检查OPEN并交换KEEPALIVE，进入Established状态。保持时: Both peers check OPEN and exchange KEEPALIVE messages to enter Established. With a nonzero hold time, subsequent KEEPALIVE or UPDATE messages keep the session alive.
接收方按导入策略过滤路由并选路。符合安装条件的路由进入路由表，再由转发表用于实际: The receiver filters and selects routes according to import policy. Eligible routes enter the routing table, and the forwarding table supports actual packet forwarding.
多协议扩展可通告IPv6路由: Multiprotocol extensions can advertise IPv6 routes
提供自治系统内部路由: Provide routing within an autonomous system
BGP以TCP承载路由控制消息，本图按承载关系放在应用层。它使用路径属性和本地策: BGP carries routing-control messages over TCP and is placed in the application layer here by its transport. It selects routes using path attributes and local policy; OSPF computes shortest paths using link costs.
图示为简化eBGP交互，未展开完整状态机和属性比较顺序。: This simplified eBGP exchange omits the full state machine and attribute comparison order.
协商密钥、认证对端，并保护应用数据的机密性和完整性。: Negotiate keys, authenticate the peer, and protect application-data confidentiality and integrity.
客户端发送支持的版本、密码套件和密钥共享等参数，还可通过SNI和ALPN扩展提供: The client sends supported versions, cipher suites and key shares. SNI and ALPN extensions can supply the server name and application-protocol list.
服务器选择参数并发送密钥共享。双方结合密钥交换结果和握手上下文，派生握手流量密钥: The server selects parameters and sends a key share. Both endpoints derive handshake traffic keys from the key exchange and handshake context.
服务器发送加密的握手消息。客户端检查证书信任链、目标名称、Certificate: The server sends encrypted handshake messages. The client checks the certificate chain, target name, CertificateVerify signature and Finished to verify server identity and handshake integrity.
客户端发送Finished，确认握手内容并证明掌握握手密钥。服务器要求客户端证书: The client sends Finished to confirm the handshake and prove possession of the handshake keys. If client certificates are requested, Certificate and CertificateVerify come first.
双方用派生的应用流量密钥和认证加密算法保护数据。证书中的公钥用于身份认证，应用内: Both endpoints protect data using derived application traffic keys and authenticated encryption. The certificate public key authenticates identity; symmetric keys encrypt application content.
使用TLS 1.3握手和QUIC包保护: Use the TLS 1.3 handshake and QUIC packet protection
TLS提供安全保护，TCP提供可靠交付，两者职责不同。加密后仍可观察到部分元数据: TLS provides security; TCP provides reliable delivery. Some metadata, such as endpoints and traffic volume, remains observable after encryption. Optional 0-RTT requires applications to consider replay risks.
图示为基于证书和密钥交换的完整握手，省略HelloRetryRequest和会话: This certificate-based full key-exchange handshake omits HelloRetryRequest and session resumption. The OSI view illustrates presentation functions; the TCP/IP view places it in the application layer.
UTF-8 · 从码点到字节: UTF-8 · From code points to bytes
按统一规则把Unicode码点编码为字节，接收端使用同一规则解码。: Encode Unicode code points into bytes using a common rule; the receiver decodes with the same rule.
HTTP等协议承载这些字节，字符编码由应用格式或协议字段约定。: Protocols such as HTTP carry these bytes; application formats or protocol fields specify character encoding.
接收端按UTF-8还原码点。编码约定不一致时可能产生乱码，即使传输收到的字节完全: The receiver recovers code points using UTF-8. An encoding mismatch can produce garbled text even when all transmitted bytes arrive correctly.
开放系统间的JSON交换要求UTF-8: JSON exchanged between open systems must use UTF-8
UTF-8是字符编码。一个码点需要1至4字节，一个用户感知字符可能由多个码点组成: UTF-8 is a character encoding. Each code point occupies 1–4 bytes; one user-perceived character may contain several code points. Fields such as Content-Length count bytes; string length depends on the language and API.
用文本交换结构化数据，字段含义和验证规则由应用约定。: Exchange structured data as text; applications define field meanings and validation rules.
RFC 8259要求开放系统间交换的JSON文本使用UTF-8。数字范围、日期写: RFC 8259 requires UTF-8 for JSON text exchanged between open systems. Applications still need to agree on numeric ranges, date formats and field meanings.
JSON可放在HTTP消息体或WebSocket文本消息中。直接使用TCP时，应: JSON can appear in an HTTP body or WebSocket text message. When using TCP directly, applications must define message boundaries with lengths, delimiters or another mechanism.
接收端解析JSON语法，再检查字段类型、必需字段和业务规则。语法正确的输入仍可能: The receiver parses JSON syntax, then checks field types, required fields and business rules. Syntactically valid input can still contain unacceptable application data.
JSON可作为消息载荷: JSON can serve as a message payload
JSON没有原生日期或二进制类型，也无法保留所有语言对象特性。跨语言交换时应约定: JSON has no native date or binary type and cannot preserve every language-specific object feature. Cross-language exchange needs agreed numeric ranges and precision, and should avoid duplicate object member names.
RPC · 请求关联与调用结果: RPC · Request correlation and call results
将远程操作表示为调用请求，处理参数、结果和失败。: Represent remote operations as calls and handle arguments, results and failures.
调用代理编码方法和参数，并建立请求关联信息。ONC RPC、JSON-RPC可使: The call proxy encodes a method and arguments and establishes request correlation. ONC RPC and JSON-RPC can use message IDs; gRPC distinguishes calls through mechanisms such as HTTP/2 streams.
通过相应应用协议和底层传输发送请求。并发调用的响应需与请求对应，具体关联方式取决: Send the request over the relevant application protocol and transport. Concurrent responses must match their requests; the correlation mechanism depends on the RPC protocol.
响应通过相应关联机制交回调用方。超时后重试需要结合幂等性、去重或状态查询，避免重: Correlation delivers the response to the caller. Retries after timeouts require idempotency, deduplication or status queries to avoid duplicate execution.
部分RPC协议直接通过TCP传输: Some RPC protocols run directly over TCP
RPC包括多种协议和实现方式。远程执行成功后，响应仍可能丢失，因此可靠传输本身无: RPC includes many protocols and implementations. A response can be lost after successful remote execution, so reliable transport alone cannot guarantee exactly-once business operations.
这里展示与会话管理有关的功能；RPC在实际TCP/IP栈中属于应用层机制。: This diagram illustrates functions related to session management; in actual TCP/IP stacks, RPC is an application-layer mechanism.
在多个请求之间关联用户身份和状态，并控制会话有效期。: Associate user identity and state across requests and control session expiration.
服务器创建会话，通过Set-Cookie返回不可预测的标识，并为Cookie设置: The server creates a session and returns an unpredictable identifier through Set-Cookie, with appropriate Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite attributes.
服务器逐次检查会话有效期和操作权限，注销或过期后使会话失效。: The server checks session validity and operation permissions on each request, and invalidates the session on logout or expiration.
远程调用也需要请求关联: Remote calls also need request correlation
OSI会话层、网站登录会话和TCP连接属于不同概念。这里采用服务器端会话；无状态: OSI sessions, website login sessions and TCP connections are different concepts. This example uses server-side sessions; stateless tokens have different verification and revocation mechanisms. Checkpoints and resumable operations need separate application design.
应用会话管理是一类机制，图中以网站登录为例。: Application session management is a class of mechanisms; this example uses website login.
TCP · 字节确认与丢失恢复: TCP · Byte acknowledgment and loss recovery
提供有序字节流，通过序列号、确认和重传恢复丢失的数据。: Provide an ordered byte stream and recover lost data using sequence numbers, acknowledgments and retransmission.
发送包含1501～2000字节的报文段，但该报文段在途中丢失。: A segment carrying bytes 1501–2000 is sent but lost in transit.
发送端依据重传超时或其他丢失检测机制补发数据。图中重传相同的字节范围，实际重传时: The sender resends data after a retransmission timeout or other loss detection. This diagram retransmits the same byte range; actual retransmission may use different segment boundaries.
接收端补齐连续字节后，累计确认号推进到2001，字节按顺序供应用读取。TCP确认: Once contiguous bytes are complete, the cumulative acknowledgment advances to 2001 and the application reads them in order. TCP acknowledgments indicate transport reception; application processing needs separate confirmation.
可发送量受接收窗口rwnd、拥塞窗口cwnd和在途数据量约束。TCP是字节流，应: Sending is limited by receive window rwnd, congestion window cwnd and bytes in flight. TCP is a byte stream, so applications must define message boundaries. SYN and FIN each consume one sequence number; pure ACK does not. Unrecoverable connection failures are still reported to the application.
图示从已建立的连接开始，侧重丢失恢复；握手和关闭在TCP/UDP实验中展示。: This diagram begins with an established connection and focuses on loss recovery; the TCP/UDP lab covers establishment and closing.
使用端口区分通信端点，保留每份数据报的边界。: Use ports to distinguish endpoints and preserve each datagram boundary.
数据报3到达，接收端仍缺少数据报2。应用如需检测缺失或乱序，可以在载荷中加入序号: Datagram 3 arrives while datagram 2 is missing. Applications needing loss or reordering detection can include sequence information in the payload.
在UDP上实现可靠、安全的传输: Implement reliable, secure transport over UDP
UDP首部包含源端口、目的端口、长度和校验和，各占16位。IPv4中的零校验和表: The UDP header contains source port, destination port, length and checksum, each 16 bits. A zero IPv4 UDP checksum means omitted checking. IPv6 normally requires a UDP checksum, with restricted exceptions for certain tunnels. Numbers in this diagram are application data; UDP headers have no datagram sequence number.
示例展示丢失；UDP路径还可能出现乱序或重复。: This example shows loss; UDP traffic can also arrive out of order or duplicated.
QUIC · 安全握手与多流传输: QUIC · Secure handshake and multiple streams
在UDP上实现流复用、丢失恢复、拥塞控制和TLS 1.3握手。: Implement stream multiplexing, loss recovery, congestion control and a TLS 1.3 handshake over UDP.
服务器返回TLS握手信息，客户端验证服务器身份，双方建立应用数据密钥。TLS握手: The server returns TLS handshake information; the client verifies server identity, and both derive application-data keys. QUIC carries the TLS handshake and protects data using QUIC packet protection.
同一连接中的流各自交付有序字节。一个流缺少数据时，其他流仍可交付已收到的连续字节: Streams within a connection deliver ordered bytes independently. Missing data in one stream does not prevent others from delivering received contiguous bytes.
接收端通过ACK帧确认已收到的包范围。发送端检测到丢失后，在新包中重新发送仍需交: ACK frames identify received packet ranges. After detecting loss, the sender resends still-needed data in new packets with new packet numbers.
握手确认后，客户端在允许迁移的条件下可换用新地址。连接ID用于识别连接，路径验证: After handshake confirmation, a client may switch addresses when migration is permitted. Connection IDs identify the connection; path validation checks reachability over the new path.
QUIC自行完成确认、恢复、拥塞控制和流量控制。独立流交付减少传输层跨流队头阻塞: QUIC handles acknowledgments, recovery, congestion control and flow control. Independent streams reduce transport-level head-of-line blocking across streams, but each stream still waits for missing bytes, and applications can have cross-stream dependencies. Migration depends on negotiated parameters and connection IDs.
按目的地址查路由并选择下一跳，提供尽力而为的分组交付。: Look up the destination route, select a next hop and provide best-effort packet delivery.
① 查路由并选择下一跳: ① Look up route and next hop
主机按目的地址查路由。直连路由通常把目的主机作为下一跳，跨网段路由通常指向网关；: The host looks up the destination route. A connected route usually selects the destination itself; a remote route usually selects a gateway. Ethernet then resolves that next-hop MAC address with ARP.
路由器移除当前链路封装，按最长前缀匹配查路由。转发时减少TTL并更新IPv4首部: The router removes the current link encapsulation and applies longest-prefix matching. Forwarding decrements TTL and updates the IPv4 header checksum; an expired TTL causes a drop.
路由器使用出接口的源MAC和下一跳的目的MAC重新封装，普通转发保持源、目的IP: The router re-encapsulates with its outgoing-interface source MAC and the next-hop destination MAC. Ordinary forwarding preserves source and destination IPs. Oversized packets are fragmented or discarded with error feedback according to MTU and DF.
完成每条以太网链路的帧交付: Deliver frames across each Ethernet link
IPv4地址为32位，基本首部为20字节。最长前缀匹配选择最具体的匹配路由，默认: IPv4 has 32-bit addresses and a 20-byte base header. Longest-prefix matching chooses the most specific matching route; default /0 applies when no more specific route matches. NAT rewrites addresses; NAPT can also rewrite ports.
图示假定各跳使用以太网，省略NAT、隧道和策略路由。: This diagram assumes Ethernet at every hop and omits NAT, tunnels and policy routing.
IPv6 · 邻居解析与路径MTU: IPv6 · Neighbor resolution and path MTU
使用128位地址、40字节基本首部和扩展首部机制。: Use 128-bit addresses, a 40-byte base header and extension headers.
基本首部包含源地址、目的地址、Next Header和Hop Limit等字段。: The base header includes source address, destination address, Next Header and Hop Limit. IPv6 has no base-header checksum.
③ 检查Hop Limit与MTU: ③ Check Hop Limit and MTU
路由器转发时减少Hop Limit，耗尽时丢弃并报告超时。分组超过出链路MTU时: Forwarding decrements Hop Limit; expiration causes a drop and a Time Exceeded response. A packet exceeding the outgoing-link MTU is also dropped, with the MTU reported through ICMPv6 Packet Too Big.
④ 转发符合MTU的分组: ④ Forward packets that fit the MTU
符合转发条件的分组继续发往下一跳。源端根据路径MTU调整发送大小，必要时使用分片: Eligible packets continue to the next hop. The source adjusts sizes for the path MTU and can use a Fragment extension header if needed; the destination performs reassembly.
完成邻居发现和MTU反馈: Provide neighbor discovery and MTU feedback
Next Header指向下一个扩展首部或上层协议。IPv6提供单播、组播和任播: Next Header identifies the next extension header or upper-layer protocol. IPv6 defines unicast, multicast and anycast, but no broadcast. NDP can use multicast or unicast. IPv6 routers do not fragment; security still requires separate configuration.
第三步包含丢弃分支，只有符合条件的分组进入第四步。: Step three includes a discard branch; only eligible packets proceed to step four.
报告部分IP处理差错，并提供回显等诊断报文。: Report some IP-processing errors and provide diagnostic messages such as Echo.
目标可返回回显应答，中间路由器可返回超时报文。ICMP差错报文包含原始分组的部分: The destination may return an Echo Reply; intermediate routers may return Time Exceeded. ICMP errors include part of the original packet so the sender can associate the response with a probe.
工具匹配反馈并计算往返时间或记录路径节点。过滤、限速和路径故障都可能导致无回应，: The tool matches feedback and calculates round-trip times or records hops. Filtering, rate limiting and path faults can all cause missing replies; compare with actual connection behavior.
TCP服务需另行连接测试: Test TCP services with a separate connection
ICMP使用类型、代码和校验和字段，没有TCP或UDP端口。ICMP提供差错反馈: ICMP has type, code and checksum fields, with no TCP or UDP ports. It reports errors but does not retransmit IP packets. A successful Echo probe only establishes that a reply arrived; service health needs additional checks.
在自治系统内部交换链路状态，根据链路代价计算路径。: Exchange link state within an autonomous system and calculate paths using link costs.
交换Hello并检查关键参数，建立邻居关系。是否进一步建立完全邻接，取决于链路类: Routers exchange Hello messages and check key parameters to form neighbor relationships. Full adjacency also depends on link type and roles such as DR/BDR.
邻接路由器通过数据库描述、链路状态请求和更新报文同步链路状态通告（LSA），收敛: Adjacent routers synchronize Link State Advertisements (LSAs) through Database Description, Link State Request and Link State Update packets. After convergence, routers in the same area have consistent databases.
链路变化触发相关LSA更新。序列号、LSA寿命和确认机制帮助识别新旧信息并可靠传: Link changes trigger LSA updates. Sequence numbers, LSA age and acknowledgments distinguish newer information and propagate updates reliably.
每台路由器以自身为根计算最短路径树，生成相应路由，再由路由表和转发表支持数据转发: Each router computes a shortest-path tree rooted at itself and generates routes; routing and forwarding tables support packet delivery.
OSPF属于控制平面，实际IP转发属于数据平面。区域和骨干区域组织拓扑，广播等网: OSPF operates in the control plane; IP forwarding operates in the data plane. Areas and the backbone organize the topology. DR/BDR roles reduce adjacency and flooding overhead on broadcast and similar networks.
